title: Philodemus, Index Academicorum (PHerc. 1021 and 164), in Mekler's edition (Berlin: Weidmann, 1902)

license.payload: Philodemus (d. c. 40 BCE) is public domain. Mekler's Academicorum philosophorum index Herculanensis (Berlin: Weidmann, 1902) is public domain in the United States (published before 1931); Mekler died in 1912, so it is public domain everywhere. The Archive marks the item NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT. The OCR was made in session from the Archive's page images and is released with this seat record.
license.record: CC-BY-4.0 applies to this seat record only.

normalization: The Archive's own OCR of this volume reads the Greek as Latin and is not used. The leaves named in origin.items were OCR'd in session; Mekler prints each column twice, the papyrus in majuscule as the apographs give it and his restored text beneath, and the OCR of the majuscule is poor. The OCR of each leaf is kept under original/, and the page images are held by URL and sha256. The OCR is kept as made, with line endings normalized. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings and say where those differ from the printed page.

scope: Mekler's edition from the end of its preface through the text and his chronological table, up to the indices (pp. XXXIII–120): the columns of PHerc. 1021 and 164, each printed in the apographs' majuscule with Mekler's restoration beneath, an apparatus naming who supplied each supplement, and the parallel testimonia. At Col. VI, the list of Plato's pupils, the apparatus says the names of Speusippus and Xenocrates are supplied by Spengel by comparison with Diogenes (Speusippi et Xenocratis nomina Diogene conl. suppl. Sp.), and the testimonia print Diogenes III.46. Dorandi's edition (1991) is in copyright and goes to 32/11.
why_seated: The Index Academicorum is a history of the Academy written as a succession of named heads and pupils, with the lives and the books attached to each name. The study reads it beside Diogenes Laertius and the Peripatetic wills as the Academy's own form of the slot.
